 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Extend the inner color outward by the thickness of the surrounding frame."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    inner = [(r, c) for r, c in cells if grid[r][c] not in (0, grid[r0][c0])]
    # The enclosed non-frame color is the color to extend. The border thickness
    # is the minimum distance from the inner object to the outer rectangle.
    if not inner:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = grid[inner[0][0]][inner[0][1]]
    ir0 = min(r for r, c in inner)
    ir1 = max(r for r, c in inner)
    ic0 = min(c for r, c in inner)
    ic1 = max(c for r, c in inner)
    thickness = min(ir0-r0, r1-ir1, ic0-c0, c1-ic1)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0-thickness), min(h, r1+thickness+1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0-thickness), min(w, c1+thickness+1)):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
"
